name: baoyu-skills
tagline_zh: 翻译、写作、播客、信息处理，中文场景全覆盖。每个技能都带真实案例，不是空壳模板，装完就能用。
tagline_en: Translation, writing, podcast, info processing—all in Chinese. Each skill ships with real examples, not empty.
desc_en: 宝玉的 Claude 技能合集：翻译、写作、播客、信息处理等中文场景技能包
why_zh: 同类合集多堆数量，它却按中文使用习惯打磨，连 prompt 里的语气词都调过，上手零障碍。
why_en: While others pile up skills, this one is tuned for Chinese usage—even tone particles in prompts are polished, so it works out of.
